narr: A mesoscale convective vortex developed along the Rio Grande and moved northeastward across South-Central Texas. Thunderstorms from this complex produced locally heavy rain that led to flash flooding.
ev: Thunderstorms produced heavy rain that led to flash flooding closing Hwy 127 at the Frio River in Concan.

Thunderstorms produced heavy rain that led to flash flooding closing RM 1051 at the confluence of Brushy Creek and the Dry Frio River near Reagan Wells.
Thunderstorms produced heavy rain that led to flash flooding closing the low water crossing on CR 312 at Honey Creek southeast of Llano.
Thunderstorms produced heavy rain that led to flash flooding closing FM 1908 at the Maverick County Canal east of Quemado.
Thunderstorms produced heavy rain that led to flash flooding closing Hwy 277 at Quemado Creek south of Normandy.
